name: Ministral 8B
notes: PARAMS: 8.02B is the safetensors count. KV: 36 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 147,456 bytes/token = 144 KiB/token. SLIDING WINDOW THAT NEVER BINDS: sliding_window is set to 32768, exactly equal to max_position_embeddings, so at any usable context the window covers the entire sequence and behaves as standard full attention. Recording it as 'sliding-window' would be misleading; it is a full-attention model with the mechanism present but inert. LICENCE IS NOT PRODUCTION: the Ministral release is under Mistral's research licence, unlike the Apache-2.0 Mixtral line. That is a deployment blocker independent of architecture.
